A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our framework is capable to jointly recover the structure of a complex scene, estimate camera poses, and recognize objects and regions in the 3-D world.

our framework is capable to jointly solve SFM and semantic scene understanding in a single framework, which is not possible with current state-of-the-art methods.
The main takeaway from our work is that
joint inference of 3D scene structure and high level scene semantics is a promising approach to improve the accuracy of SFM and semantic recognition.
by jointly modeling the 3D geometry and semantic structure of a scene we can achieve better results than by solving these problems in a piecemeal fashion.
joint inference is a promising avenue for future research in computer vision, especially in the context of high level scene understanding.
